name: shared-web
description: Code shared between the web (rider), driver-web and admin Vite apps — the API client factory, domain types, theme, and a handful of pages/components that are identical (or differ only by additive, role-specific fields) between web and driver-web. Referenced via a file: dependency from each app's package.json. No single entry point — always imported by subpath, e.g. `shared-web/src/theme`.
